title: Reduced affine flat model with geometrically reduced generic fibre after radicial base change
statement: Let $X$ be affine and $f:X\to T$ locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], with image in an affine open $V\subseteq T$. Let $\eta$ be a generic point of $T$ and suppose $X_\eta$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] is geometrically irreducible [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. There are an open $U\subseteq T$ containing $\eta$, integral affine $S$ [def-pc-integral-scheme], reduced affine $Y$, a universal homeomorphism $q:S\to U$, and a flat locally finitely presented map $g:Y\to S$ [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. There is a generic point $\eta\prime$ of $S$ with $q(\eta\prime)=\eta$ and geometrically reduced $Y_{\eta\prime}$. For every $s\in S$, $Y_s$ is geometrically irreducible if and only if $X_{q(s)}$ is geometrically irreducible. Here $q(s)$ is regarded as a point of $T$ via $U\hookrightarrow T$. No assertion that any nongeneric fibre is irreducible is made.

proof.text: Factor through the affine base open, reduce source and base, and apply generic flat finite presentation. Restrict to a principal base open so both schemes stay affine. The base is integral and the reduced flat source ring embeds in its integral generic fibre.

For the generic function field L/K, choose a finite purely inseparable extension K\prime/K making the reduced compositum separably generated. If a field generator b satisfies b^q=a/d, scale it to db; its q-th power is a*d^(q-1) in the base ring. The algebra of these scaled generators is finite radicial integral, has fraction field K\prime, and its spectrum is a universal homeomorphism.

Base change the family and reduce the source. The reduced generic fibre embeds, after field extensions, in its separably generated function field, hence is geometrically reduced. Apply generic flat finite presentation again. The image of the resulting base open is open under the base universal homeomorphism; choose a principal original-base open inside this image and pull it back, retaining affine source and integral affine base.

The base homeomorphism lifts the generic point uniquely. Source reduction and radicial base change preserve geometric fibre spaces at every point, so geometric irreducibility is equivalent in the new and original fibres. This yields the stated pointwise comparison, without claiming that any special fibre is already irreducible.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_generic_radicial_geometrically_reduced_model
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] (f : X ⟶ T) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (V : T.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (himage : Set.range f ⊆ V)
    (η : T) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ)
    (hgeom : GeometricallyIrreducible (f.fiberToSpecResidueField η)) :
    ∃ (U : T.Opens), η ∈ U ∧
      ∃ (S Y : Scheme.{u}) (q : S ⟶ U.toScheme) (g : Y ⟶ S),
        IsAffine S ∧ IsIntegral S ∧ IsAffine Y ∧ IsReduced Y ∧
        IsUniversalHomeomorphism q ∧ Flat g ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation g ∧
        ∃ η' : S, IsGenericPoint η' Set.univ ∧ (q ≫ U.ι) η' = η ∧
          GeometricallyReduced (g.fiberToSpecResidueField η') ∧
          ∀ s : S, GeometricallyIrreducible (g.fiberToSpecResidueField s) ↔
            GeometricallyIrreducible (f.fiberToSpecResidueField ((q ≫ U.ι) s))
